name: LS Eco Energy Ltd.
summary: LS Eco Energy Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and distribution of electric power and communication cables through its subsidiaries. It operates through the following business divisions: LS-VINA Cable & System, LS Cable & System Vietnam, and LS-Gaon Cable Myanmar. The LS-VINA Cable & System division provides HV, MV, and LV electric power cables; overhead wires; and industrial materials. The LS Cable & System Vietnam division offers optical and UTP communication cables; MV and LV electric power cables; and busducts. The LS-Gaon Cable Myanmar division includes LV electric power cables and overhead wires. The company was founded on May 15, 2015 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
